title: Observational Indistinguishability and Integrity Blind Regions in Hybrid Quantum-Classical Workflows
description: Version 1.3.6 is a final formal and editorial corrective release. It corrects the rate-level interpretation of Proposition 4(i), repairs a dependency omission in a corollary proof, sharpens claim-relative reference granularity, and updates current related-work positioning and presentation. No experiment, dataset, model, kernel, seed, intervention, calibration draw, policy decision, quantum cell or scientific evidence file was re-executed or changed. A presentation-only clean-performance summary was derived from frozen evidence; no underlying scientific observation changed.
